description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver subclass 'RepeatingAlarm' that displays a toast message when an alarm event occurs. It is part of an Android application demonstrating alarm handling.

classes.name: RepeatingAlarm
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles alarm receipt and shows a toast message.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Called when the BroadcastReceiver receives an intent; displays a toast message indicating the alarm was received.
